title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Introduction

NextDay AI is a privately held company and world leader specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join our team. The candidate will have the mission of bringing his expertise and contribution in the rapid growth of one of our current star products. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining both the front-end and back-end of our web applications, while working in a very tight group of collaborators in a growth hacking mode, constantly integrating new cutting edge AI technologies in the context of a high volume traffic web application.


This role requires a strong understanding of the entire development process, including design, development, and deployment, and a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and the creation of quality products.


What the ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Availability to work with North American hours
  • Strong experience in building user interfaces and backend services using Typescript/React/Next.js.
  • Deep understanding of TypeScript, typing patterns, interfaces, generics, and strict type safety.
  • Experience building REST APIs and/or Route Handlers / Server Actions in Next.js.
  • Experience building React based frontend component with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or other styling systems.
  • Thorough understanding of PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization).
  • Experience with third-party API integrations (webhooks, auth etc.).
  • Experience deploying Next.js apps on Vercel, AWS, or other cloud providers.
  • Familiarity with logging/monitoring tools (Sentry, Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of version control systems, such as Git.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
  • Strong sense of ownership and urgency, with a commitment to delivering high-quality, polished products.
  • Proven ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Creative and analytical mindset for tackling complex technical challenges and driving innovative solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications from end-to-end.
  • Implement user interface and user experience (UI/UX) designs using front-end technologies.
  • Develop and manage back-end services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces).
  • Integrate front-end components with back-end logic.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and efficient code.
  • Perform testing and debugging to ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver new features.
  • Maintain code integrity and organization, and participate in code reviews.
  • Stay up-to-date with new technologies and industry best practices.


Why Join Us?

  • You love building real, meaningful features—not just completing tickets
  • You want autonomy and real ownership.
  • You enjoy solving problems across frontend, backend, and database.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
  • You care about clean code and great user experience.
  • We offer Unlimited Vacations Policy.
  • You want a Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to \"once per week\").
  • You want Flex-time and Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results).
  • You want an opportunity to work closely with leadership and gain cross-functional experience in a fast-growing company at the forefront of the AI revolution.


If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team in the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição Estamos com oportunidade aberta para Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho e buscamos profissionais interessados em fazer parte do nosso time, contribuindo para a promoção da saúde, segurança e prevenção de riscos no ambiente de trabalho. Responsabilidades e atribuições - Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações e ambientes de trabalho, identificando riscos e propondo melhorias. - Elaborar e implementar programas de prevenção e controle de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais. - Ministrar treinamentos sobre segurança do trabalho e procedimentos de emergência para os colaboradores. - Investigar acidentes de trabalho, registrando as causas e propondo ações corretivas e preventivas. - Colaborar na elaboração de documentos técnicos, como PPRA, PCMSO e laudos de condições ambientais. - Acompanhar a implementação de medidas de segurança e promover a conscientização sobre práticas seguras. - Garantir o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras e da legislação pertinente à segurança do trabalho. - Manter atualizados os registros e documentações relacionadas à segurança no trabalho. Requisitos e qualificações • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho reconhecido pelo MEC;  • Estágio na área Segurança do Trabalho; • Registro Profissional no Ministério do Trabalho e Previdência; • Experiência comprovada na carteira de no mínimo 6 meses como Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho; • Conhecimento de normas de segurança, legislação e saúde ocupacional. • Capacidade de identificar, avaliar e propor medidas para minimizar riscos ocupacionais.
